ieltsWriting.title: AI IELTS Writing Examiner
ieltsWriting.subtitle: Real IELTS imtihon muhiti, rasmiy vaqt va 4 ta mezon (TR, CC, LR, GRA) bo'yicha sun'iy intellekt tahlili.
ieltsWriting.t1q1Prompt: The graph below shows energy consumption by fuel type in the USA from 1980 to 2030. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
ieltsWriting.t1q2Prompt: The bar chart below compares the percentage of university graduates in six European countries who found employment within six months of graduation between 2010 and 2020. Summarize the key trends.
ieltsWriting.t1q3Prompt: The diagram illustrates the process of purifying and recycling wastewater for domestic consumption. Describe the stages involved in this system.
ieltsWriting.t2q1Prompt: Some people believe that artificial intelligence will replace human workers in most industries, while others argue it will create new opportunities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
ieltsWriting.t2q2Title: Task 2: Higher Education vs Practical Skills
ieltsWriting.t2q2Prompt: Many young people prefer going directly into employment after high school rather than pursuing a university degree. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
ieltsWriting.t2q3Prompt: Global climate change and environmental degradation are major threats today. Should governments take sole responsibility for solving environmental issues, or should individuals change their lifestyle habits? Discuss.
ieltsWriting.placeholder: Inshoingizni bu yerga yozing... IELTS mezoniga mos holda kirish, asosiy paragraflar va xulosalarni shakllantiring.
ieltsWriting.underLengthTip: IELTS mezoniga ko'ra kamida belgilangan so'zdan iborat insho yozing.
ieltsWriting.impWordCount: So'zlar soni kam. Belgilangan hajmdan ko'proq yozing.
ieltsWriting.strCollocations: B2/C1 darajadagi akademik iboralar to'g'ri qo'llanildi.
ieltsWriting.impCollocations: Inshoda B2/C1 darajadagi akademik collocations va so'z birikmalarini ko'proq qo'llang.
ieltsWriting.impConnectors: Paragraflar o'rtasida 'Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'In contrast' kabi bog'lovchilarni oshiring.
ieltsWriting.strParagraphs: Paragraf strukturasi va insho strukturasi aniq bo'lindi.
ieltsWriting.impParagraphs: Inshoni kamida 3-4 ta aniq paragrafga bo'ling (Kirish, Asosiy qismlar, Xulosa).
ieltsWriting.trDesc: Mavzu talabi va so'z hajmi qamrovi.
ieltsWriting.p1Prompt: Some people think that mobile phones should be banned in schools, while others believe they are useful educational tools. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
ieltsWriting.p2Title: Task 1: Chiziqli grafik - Jamoat transporti yo'lovchilari
ieltsWriting.p2Prompt: The line graph below shows the number of passengers using three types of public transport in a European city between 2000 and 2020. Summarize the main features and make comparisons.
ieltsWriting.p3Prompt: Online distance learning is replacing traditional classroom teaching in many universities. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
ieltsWriting.p4Title: Task 2: Sun'iy intellekt va kelajak kasblari
ieltsWriting.p4Prompt: Some people believe that artificial intelligence will replace human workers in most industries, while others argue it will create new opportunities. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
ieltsWriting.p5Prompt: The bar chart compares the percentage of university graduates in six European countries who found employment within six months of graduation between 2010 and 2020. Summarize key trends.
ieltsWriting.p6Title: Task 2: Erta ishlash vs Oliy ta'lim
ieltsWriting.p6Prompt: Many young people prefer going directly into employment after high school rather than pursuing a university degree. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
ieltsWriting.p7Title: Task 1: Jarayon diagrammasi - Suvni qayta ishlash
ieltsWriting.p7Prompt: The diagram illustrates the process of purifying and recycling wastewater for domestic consumption. Describe the stages involved in this system.
ieltsWriting.p8Prompt: Should governments take sole responsibility for solving environmental issues, or should individuals change their lifestyle habits? Discuss both views and give your opinion.
ieltsWriting.p9Prompt: Providing a Universal Basic Income (UBI) to all citizens regardless of employment status is proposed as a solution to wealth inequality. Discuss the feasibility and potential consequences.
ieltsWriting.p10Title: Task 1: Doiraviy diagrammalar - Energiya ishlab chiqarish 2005 vs 2035
ieltsWriting.p10Prompt: The pie charts show the proportions of energy generated from different sources in a developed nation in 2005 and projected figures for 2035. Summarize the main features and make comparisons.
ieltsWriting.p11Title: Task 2: Globallashuv va yo'qolib borayotgan tillar
ieltsWriting.p11Prompt: Due to globalization, many minority languages are dying out. Some argue that public money should be spent on preserving endangered languages, while others consider it a waste of resources. Discuss both views.
ieltsWriting.p12Title: Task 1: Xarita - Shaharni qayta qurish rejalari
ieltsWriting.p12Prompt: The maps below show the town of Willington in 1995 and proposed redevelopment plans for 2025. Summarize the main features and make comparisons where relevant.
ieltsWriting.p13Prompt: The amount of money spent on space exploration is unjustifiable when there are so many problems on Earth. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ieltsWriting.p14Prompt: The primary purpose of prisons should be to punish criminals rather than to rehabilitate them. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ieltsWriting.p15Title: Task 1: Jarayon diagrammasi - Qahva ishlab chiqarish
ieltsWriting.p15Prompt: The diagram illustrates the stages of commercial coffee production, from harvesting beans to final packaging. Summarize the information by reporting the main features.

ieltsWriting.t2Instruction1: Javobingizni asoslang va o'zingizning bilimingiz yoki tajribangizdan tegishli misollar keltiring.

asilbek.description: Asilbek ketma-ket 3 marta IELTS 9.0 ballini olgan, va bu tasodif emas. Uning har bir darsi bitta g'oya atrofida quriladi — «imkonsiz» so'zini odamlar yetarlicha harakat qilmasdan turib ishlatishadi. U har bir ko'nikmani tushunarli qadamlarga bo'lib beradi, o'quvchining zaif tomonlarini doimiy kuzatib boradi va ko'pchilik tiqilib qoladigan bosqichdan olib o'tadi. Uning o'quvchilari nafaqat imtihondan o'tishadi — ular darsdan haqiqiy ishonch bilan chiqib ketishadi. Agar mehnat qilishga tayyor bo'lsangiz, natija albatta keladi.

ruxillo.description: Ruhillo ingliz tilini maktab davridayoq mustaqil o'rganishni boshlagan va bir necha yil ichida o'z shahridagi eng talab qilinadigan o'qituvchilardan biriga aylangan. U IELTS'ga tayyorlash va nutq amaliyoti bo'yicha ixtisoslashgan bo'lib, murakkab grammatik mavzularni sodda va tushunarli tilda tushuntiradi. 4 yillik faoliyati davomida u IELTS 7 va undan yuqori ball olgan 200 dan ortiq o'quvchini tayyorlagan va o'z o'qitish metodikasini doimiy takomillashtirib bormoqda.

zarnigor.description: Zarnigor xalqaro IELTS imtihonidan 17 yoshidayoq 8.5 ball to'plagan, bu esa uning yoshi uchun haqiqiy yutuq bo'ldi. U CELTA sertifikati egasi bo'lib, nutq ko'nikmalarini rivojlantirish va talaffuz ustida ishlashga ixtisoslashgan. Zarnigor har bir o'quvchi materialni sodda va sabr bilan tushuntirilsa, yuqori natijaga erisha oladi deb ishonadi va aynan shu yondashuvni har bir darsida qo'llaydi.

gulasal.description: Gulasal IELTS'ning eng yuqori balli 9.0 va xalqaro darajada ingliz tili o'qitish huquqini beruvchi TESOL sertifikati egasidir. 5 yillik amaliyoti davomida u 600 dan ortiq o'quvchini tayyorlagan, ularning ko'pchiligi chet el universitetlariga muvaffaqiyatli o'qishga kirgan. Gulasal akademik yozuv va ishonchli og'zaki ingliz tiliga alohida e'tibor qaratib, o'quvchilarga nafaqat imtihondan o'tishga, balki tilni haqiqatan ham egallashga yordam beradi.

faq.title: Ko'p beriladigan savollar
faq.subtitle: Kurslar, to'lovlar, dars jadvali va IELTS tayyorgarligi haqida barcha tafsilotlar.
faq.a1: Kurslarimiz yo'nalishiga qarab o'rtacha 3 oydan 12 oygacha davom etadi. Darslar haftasiga 4 marta malakali ustozlar tomonidan olib boriladi.
faq.q2: Darslarni boshlash uchun nima talab qilinadi?
faq.a2: Boshlash uchun sizdan faqat noutbuk (kompyuter), kerakli kitoblar, internet va kuchli xohish-istak talab etiladi. Boshlang'ich bilimlar noldan o'rgatiladi.
faq.q3: Darsda qatnasha olmay qolsam nima bo'ladi?
faq.a3: Har bir darsda faol qatnashish tavsiya etiladi. Agar darsga kela olmay qolsangiz yoki qaysidir mavzuni tushunmay qiynalsangiz, markazimizdagi tajribali assistent o'qituvchilar darsdan tashqari vaqtlarda sizga yaqindan yordam berib, o'tilgan mavzularni qaytadan tushuntirib berishadi va amaliy mashqlarni bajarishda ko'maklashishadi.
faq.a4: Ha, kursni muvaffaqiyatli tamomlagan bitiruvchilarga maxsus sertifikat beriladi va eng yaxshi o'quvchilarga ish topishda amaliy yordam ko'rsatiladi.
faq.a5: Kurs narxlari darajangizga va guruh yoki yakka tartibdagi darslarga qarab o'zgaradi. Aniq ma'lumot olish uchun narxlar sahifasiga o'ting yoki biz bilan bog'laning.
faq.a6: Darslar haftada 3 kun asosiy va 1 kun qo'shimcha Speaking Club sifatida o'tiladi. Sizga mos vaqtni tanlash imkoniyati mavjud.
faq.a7: Ha, markazimizda barcha yangi o'quvchilar uchun birinchi sinov darsi butunlay bepul. Bu orqali siz dars jarayoni va o'qituvchi bilan yaqindan tanishishingiz mumkin.
faq.a8: Uy vazifalari har dars oldidan o'qituvchilar va ularning yordamchilari tomonidan qat'iy tekshiriladi. Vazifalarni bajarmaslik o'quv jarayoniga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatganligi uchun ularga jiddiy yondashamiz.
faq.a9: Albatta, bizda ham an'anaviy oflayn, ham onlayn formatda darslar mavjud. Onlayn darslar ham oflayn darslar kabi interaktiv va samarali o'tiladi.
faq.a10: Agar sizga dars uslubi tushunarsiz bo'lsa yoki boshqa guruhga o'tishni xohlasangiz, ma'muriyatimizga murojaat qilib bemalol o'qituvchini yoki vaqtni o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

principles.p1_f1_desc: Haftasiga ko'proq dars soatlari va boyitilgan o'quv materiallari orqali tilni tez o'zlashtirasiz.
principles.p1_f2_desc: Vaqtingizni tejash maqsadida faqatgina imtihonda tushadigan, eng dolzarb va kerakli strategiyalarni o'rgatamiz.
principles.p1_f3_desc: Har kungi uy vazifalari va so'z yodlash jarayoni o'qituvchilar tomonidan qat'iy nazorat qilinadi.
principles.p1_extra_desc: Ushbu tezkor metodika yordamida o'quvchilarimiz odatda 3-4 oy ichida maqsad qilingan IELTS 7.0+ yoki CEFR B2/C1 darajalariga yetishadilar. Hech qanday sehr yo'q – faqat tinimsiz mehnat va to'g'ri yo'nalish.
principles.p2_desc: Darslarimizning asosiy qismi jonli muloqot va so'zlashuv nutqiga qaratilgan bo'lib, bu sizga til to'sig'ini tezroq yengib o'tishga va erkin fikr bildirishga yordam beradi.
principles.p2_f1_desc: Darslarda qoidalar yodlash emas, balki ularni amalda qanday qo'llashni o'rganasiz. Haftalik speaking club'lar orqali nutqingizni ochamiz.
principles.p2_f2_desc: Amaliyot nafaqat gapirish, balki test yechish bilan ham bog'liq. Siz haqiqiy imtihon muhitini darslar davomida his qilasiz.
principles.p2_f3_desc: Turli xil aksentdagi audiolarni tinglash orqali siz nafaqat imtihonga, balki real hayotdagi muloqotga ham tayyor bo'lasiz.
principles.p2_extra_desc: Bizning markazda 'Nazariya 20%, Amaliyot 80%' qoidasi ishlaydi. Faqatgina qoidalarni bilish bilan yuqori ball olib bo'lmaydi, ularni avtomatik tarzda qo'llay olish muhimdir.
principles.p3_desc: Har bir o'quvchining xato va kamchiliklari ustida yakka tartibda ishlanadi. Bunga qo'shimcha ravishda o'quvchilar muntazam ravishda mock testlaridan o'tadilar, bu esa doimiy ravishda yuqori natijalarga olib keladi.
principles.p3_f1_desc: Guruhda o'qisangiz ham, sizning shaxsiy xatolaringiz chuqur tahlil qilinadi va ularni to'g'rilash bo'yicha maslahatlar beriladi.
principles.p3_f2_desc: Har oy o'tkaziladigan standart Mock Testlar orqali o'z darajangizni va o'sish dinamikangizni kuzatib borasiz.
principles.p3_f3_desc: Imtihon hayajonini yengish va vaqtni to'g'ri taqsimlash ko'nikmalarini shakllantiramiz, toki imtihon kuni o'zingizga ishonchingiz komil bo'lsin.
principles.p3_extra_desc: Mukammallik chegarasi yo'q. Bizning maqsadimiz sizni shunchaki testdan o'tkazish emas, balki ingliz tilini hayotingizning bir qismiga aylantirishdir.

ieltsWritingAssessor.allTopicsDesc: Band 5.0 dan Band 9.0 gacha bo'lgan barcha Task 1 va Task 2 insho va akademik topshiriqlarini birdaniga ko'rish.
ieltsWritingAssessor.loadSampleBtn: Namuna inshoni matnga joylash va tekshirish
ieltsWritingAssessor.strCollocationsTemplate: {{count}} ta B2/C1 darajadagi akademik ibora va collocation'lar aniqlandi.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impCollocationsTemplate: Inshoda B2/C1 akademik so'z birikmalarini (masalan: 'pivotal role', 'profound impact') ko'proq qo'llang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impConnectorsTemplate: Paragraflar o'rtasida 'Furthermore', 'Consequently', 'In contrast', 'Therefore' bog'lovchilaridan ko'proq foydalaning.
ieltsWritingAssessor.strOverview: Task 1 uchun zarur bo'lgan umumiy xulosa ('Overview') paragrafiga ega.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impOverview: Task 1 inshosiga albatta 'Overall,...' bilan boshlanadigan aniq Overview qismini qo'shing.
ieltsWritingAssessor.strParagraphs: Insho to'rtta aniq paragrafga (Kirish, 2 ta Asosiy qism, Xulosa) bo'lingan.
ieltsWritingAssessor.impParagraphs: Task 2 inshosini kamida 4 ta alohida paragrafga bo'ling (Kirish, Body 1, Body 2, Xulosa).
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip1: Kirish qismida mavzuni paraphrase qiling, keyin telefonlarning zarari va foydasini 2 ta alohida paragrafda muhokama qiling.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip2: Overview qismida eng ko'p ishlatilgan va eng kamaygan transport turini ko'rsating. Keyin raqamlar bilan taqqoslang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip3: Afzalliklari (moslashuvchanlik, arzonlik) va kamchiliklari (jonli muloqot yetishmasligi)ni aniq ajratib ko'rsating.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip4: AI tufayli yo'qoladigan kasblar va yangi yaratiladigan professional yo'nalishlarni chuqur dalillang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip5: Mamlakatlarning eng yuqori ko'rsatkichlarini pastki guruhlar bilan guruhlab solishtiring.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip6: Erta maosh olish (afzallik) bilan uzoq muddatli martaba cheklovi (kamchilik) o'rtasidagi balansni yoritib bering.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip7: Jarayonning bosqichma-bosqich o'tish zanjirini o'tuvchi so'zlar (Initially, Following this, Subsequently, Finally) bilan tasvirlang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip8: Hukumatning qonuniy vakolatlari va fuqarolarning shaxsiy mas'uliyatini sinxronlashtirish kerakligini xulosalang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip9: Iqtisodiy barqarorlik, avtomatlashtirish va moliyaviy manbalar o'rtasidagi murakkab munosabatni C1/C2 lofatlar bilan tahlil qiling.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip10: Qazilma yoqilg'ilarining pasayishini tiklanuvchi manbalarning eksponensial o'sishi bilan qarama-qarshi qo'yib taqqoslang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip11: Til va madaniyatning ajralmas aloqadorligini va iqtisodiy resurslar taqsimlanishini Band 9 darajasida mukammal mantiq bilan isbotlang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip12: Shahar xaritasining 30 yillik transformatsiyasini yo'nalishlar (shimol, janub, sharq, g'arb) va infratuzilma bo'yicha taqqoslang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip13: Koinot izlanishlaridan olingan texnologiyalar va Yerdagi muammolarga e'tiborni yuqori darajadagi sintaksis bilan yoriting.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip14: Jazo berish va qayta tarbiyalash (Rehabilitation) o'rtasidagi farqni va jinoyatning kamayishiga ta'sirini dalillang.
ieltsWritingAssessor.tip15: Kofe tayyorlash bosqichlarini xronologik tartibda va nisbat shaklida (is roasted, are packaged) yozing.
ieltsWritingAssessor.suiteDesc: O'zingizga mos IELTS Band darajasini tanlang (15 ta rasmiy mavzu). Namuna insholarni o'rganing, o'zingiz yozib ko'ring va sun'iy intellekt tahlilidan o'ting.
